name: git
description: Git workbench side panel: review staged and working-tree changes (list or tree view, unified or side-by-side diff), stage/unstage/discard files, switch/delete/merge branches (right-click a branch to merge it into the current one, create a new branch from it, or delete it), browse commit history and expand any commit's full diff, pull, push, stash, preview modified images side-by-side (old vs new), and generate AI commit messages with a custom prompt.

description_i18n.en: Git workbench side panel: review staged and working-tree changes with list/tree views and unified/side-by-side diffs, stage/unstage/discard files, switch or delete branches (local, remote-tracked or newly created), merge any branch into the current one via right-click, browse commit history and expand any commit's diff (with load-more paging), pull and push, stash (pop/apply), write and run commits, and generate AI commit messages with an optional custom prompt.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Git 工作台侧栏面板：以列表/树结构查看暂存区与工作区修改（统一/并排 diff），支持暂存、取消暂存、撤销、全部暂存/取消，切换/删除分支（本地/远程建跟踪/新建），右键分支可合并到当前分支、从其新建分支或删除，查看提交历史并展开单条提交的 diff（支持加载更多），图片文件旧版/新版并排预览比对，拉取与推送远程更新，存储/恢复/应用 stash，一键提交，并可附加自定义提示词用 AI 生成提交信息；面板自动跟踪外部文件改动。
